ei.title: Segmenting versus Integrating Work and Family
ei.subject: 9월_2023 고1 모의고사
ei.lesson: Segmenting versus Integrating Work and Family

fullPassage: Boundaries between work and home are blurring as portable digital technology makes it increasingly possible to work anywhere, anytime. Individuals differ in how they like to manage their time to meet work and outside responsibilities. Some people prefer to separate or segment roles so that boundary crossings are minimized. For example, these people might keep separate email accounts for work and family and try to conduct work at the workplace and take care of family matters only during breaks and non-work time. We've even noticed more of these "segmenters" carrying two phones — one for work and one for personal use. Flexible schedules work well for these individuals because they enable greater distinction between time at work and time in other roles. Other individuals prefer integrating work and family roles all day long. This might entail constantly trading text messages with children from the office, or monitoring emails at home and on vacation, rather than returning to work to find hundreds of messages in their inbox.

questions.passage: Boundaries between work and home are blurring as portable digital technology makes it increasingly possible to work anywhere, anytime. Individuals differ in how they like to manage their time to meet work and outside responsibilities. Some people prefer to (A)[combine / separate] or segment roles so that boundary crossings are minimized. For example, these people might keep separate email accounts for work and family and try to conduct work at the workplace and take care of family matters only during breaks and non-work time. We've even noticed more of these "segmenters" carrying two phones — one for work and one for personal use. Flexible schedules work well for these individuals because they enable greater (B)[similarity / distinction] between time at work and time in other roles. Other individuals prefer (C)[integrating / separating] work and family roles all day long. This might entail constantly trading text messages with children from the office, or monitoring emails at home and on vacation, rather than returning to work to find hundreds of messages in their inbox.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
(A) 어떤 사람들은 역할을 '분리하기(separate)'를 선호한다는 흐름 → separate (combine은 반대)

(B) 유연한 일정이 일과 다른 역할 사이에 더 큰 '구별(distinction)'을 가능하게 한다 → distinction (similarity는 반대)

(C) 다른 사람들은 일과 가정 역할을 '통합하기(integrating)'를 선호한다 → integrating (separating은 반대)

따라서 separate - distinction - integrating인 ③이 정답 ← 정답
det.tip: separate 분리하다 / distinction 구별 / integrate 통합하다

questions.passage: Boundaries between work and home are (A)[strengthening / blurring] as portable digital technology makes it increasingly possible to work anywhere, anytime. Individuals differ in how they like to manage their time to meet work and outside responsibilities. Some people prefer to separate or segment roles so that boundary crossings are (B)[maximized / minimized]. For example, these people might keep separate email accounts for work and family and try to conduct work at the workplace and take care of family matters only during breaks and non-work time. We've even noticed more of these "segmenters" carrying two phones — one for work and one for personal use. (C)[flexible / rigid] schedules work well for these individuals because they enable greater distinction between time at work and time in other roles. Other individuals prefer integrating work and family roles all day long. This might entail constantly trading text messages with children from the office, or monitoring emails at home and on vacation, rather than returning to work to find hundreds of messages in their inbox.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
(A) 휴대용 기술 때문에 일과 가정의 경계가 '흐려지고(blurring)' 있다 → blurring (strengthening은 반대)

(B) 역할을 분리해서 경계 넘나들기가 '최소화되도록(minimized)' 한다 → minimized (maximized는 반대)

(C) '유연한(flexible)' 일정이 이런 사람들에게 잘 맞는다 → flexible (rigid는 반대)

따라서 blurring - minimized - flexible인 ①이 정답 ← 정답
det.tip: blur 흐려지다 / minimize 최소화하다 / flexible 유연한

questions.passage: Boundaries between work and home are blurring as portable digital technology makes it increasingly possible to work anywhere, anytime. Individuals (A)[agree / differ] in how they like to manage their time to meet work and outside responsibilities. Some people prefer to separate or segment roles so that boundary crossings are minimized. For example, these people might keep separate email accounts for work and family and try to (B)[avoid / conduct] work at the workplace and take care of family matters only during breaks and non-work time. We've even noticed more of these "segmenters" carrying two phones — one for work and one for personal use. Flexible schedules work well for these individuals because they enable greater distinction between time at work and time in other roles. Other individuals prefer integrating work and family roles all day long. This might (C)[entail / prevent] constantly trading text messages with children from the office, or monitoring emails at home and on vacation, rather than returning to work to find hundreds of messages in their inbox.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
(A) 개인마다 시간을 관리하는 방식이 '다르다(differ)' → differ (agree는 반대)

(B) 직장에서 일을 '수행하려고(conduct)' 한다 → conduct (avoid는 반대)

(C) 이것은 끊임없이 문자를 주고받는 것을 '수반할(entail)' 수 있다 → entail (prevent는 반대)

따라서 differ - conduct - entail인 ④가 정답 ← 정답
det.tip: differ 다르다 / conduct 수행하다 / entail 수반하다

Individuals ②<u>differ</u> in how they like to manage their time to meet work and outside responsibilities. Some people prefer to separate or segment roles so that boundary crossings are ③<u>maximized</u>. For example, these people might keep separate email accounts for work and family and try to conduct work at the workplace and take care of family matters only during breaks and non-work time. We've even noticed more of these "segmenters" carrying two phones — one for work and one for personal use. ④<u>flexible</u> schedules work well for these individuals because they enable greater distinction between time at work and time in other roles. Other individuals prefer integrating work and family roles all day long. This might entail constantly trading text messages with children from the office, or monitoring emails at home and on vacation, rather than returning to work to find hundreds of messages in their inbox.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ③ maximized → minimized: 역할을 분리하면 경계 넘나들기가 '최소화된다'
det.analysis:
① blurring(흐려지는): 경계가 흐려진다는 맥락에 적절

② differ(다르다): 개인마다 방식이 다르다는 맥락에 적절

③ maximized → minimized: 역할을 분리(separate)하는 이유는 경계 넘나들기를 '최소화(minimized)'하기 위해서예요. '최대화(maximized)'는 정반대라 부적절 ← 정답

④ flexible(유연한): 유연한 일정이라는 맥락에 적절

det.korean: ② avoid → conduct: 분리하는 사람들은 직장에서 일을 '수행한다'
det.analysis:
① manage(관리하다): 시간을 관리한다는 맥락에 적절

② avoid → conduct: 역할을 분리하는 사람들은 직장에서 일을 '수행하고(conduct)' 가정 일은 쉬는 시간에만 처리해요. '피하다(avoid)'는 흐름과 반대라 부적절 ← 정답

③ distinction(구별): 일과 다른 역할 사이의 구별이라는 맥락에 적절

④ constantly(끊임없이): 끊임없이 문자를 주고받는다는 맥락에 적절

det.korean: ④ separating → integrating: 다른 사람들은 일과 가정 역할을 '통합하기'를 선호한다
det.analysis:

④ separating → integrating: 뒤에 '하루 종일 사무실에서 아이와 문자를 주고받는다'가 이어져요. 일과 가정을 '통합하는(integrating)' 사람들이라는 뜻이어야 하므로 '분리하는(separating)'은 정반대라 부적절 ← 정답

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 빈칸: differ(다르다) — 'Individuals ______ in how they like to manage their time(개인마다 시간 관리 방식이 다르다)'
det.analysis:
빈칸 뒤로 글은 시간을 관리하는 '서로 다른 두 가지 방식'(분리형, 통합형)을 소개해요. 그러니 개인마다 방식이 '다르다(differ)'는 뜻이 되어야 해요.

① agree(동의하다): 뒤에 나오는 대조적 두 유형과 안 맞아요

② differ(다르다): 서로 다른 두 유형을 소개하는 흐름에 맞아 정답 ← 정답

③ decide(결정하다): 문맥과 어긋남

④ combine(결합하다): 문맥과 무관

det.korean: 빈칸: minimized(최소화되는) — 'boundary crossings are ______(경계 넘나들기가 최소화되다)'
det.analysis:

① minimized(최소화되는): 역할 분리의 목적에 맞아 정답 ← 정답

② maximized(최대화되는): 분리하는 취지와 정반대

③ recorded(기록되는): 문맥과 무관

④ shared(공유되는): 문맥과 무관

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 빈칸: distinction(구별) — 'greater ______ between time at work and time in other roles(일하는 시간과 다른 역할의 시간 사이의 더 큰 구별)'
det.analysis:
빈칸 문장은 '유연한 일정이 이런 사람들(분리형)에게 잘 맞는다'는 흐름이에요. 분리형은 일과 다른 역할의 시간을 뚜렷이 나누고 싶어 하므로 더 큰 '구별(distinction)'을 원해요.

① confusion(혼란): 분리형이 원하는 것과 반대

② similarity(유사함): 문맥과 어긋남

③ agreement(동의): 문맥과 무관

④ distinction(구별): 시간을 뚜렷이 나눈다는 흐름에 맞아 정답 ← 정답
det.tip: distinction between A and B = A와 B 사이의 구별

questions.passage:
(A) During short breaks, these workers take care of family <u>matters</u> such as phone calls and errands.
(B) In the end, how well you balance work and rest <u>matters</u> more than anything else.
questions.stem: 다음 (A), (B)의 밑줄 친 matters의 문맥적 의미로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
(A) 'take care of family matters'는 가정의 '일/문제(matters)'를 처리한다는 뜻이에요 → 명사 '일, 문제'

(B) 'how well you balance work and rest matters more than anything'는 균형을 잡는 것이 '중요하다(matters)'는 뜻이에요 → 동사 '중요하다'

따라서 (A) 일, 문제 - (B) 중요하다인 ②가 정답 ← 정답

같은 matters라도 명사(일)와 동사(중요하다)로 다르게 쓰여요

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "light and easy to carry or move from place to place"

det.analysis:
정의: '가볍고 이곳저곳으로 나르거나 옮기기 쉬운' = portable(휴대용의)

① portable: '휴대용의' — 정의에 부합 ← 정답

② flexible: '유연한' — 정의와 다름

③ personal: '개인의' — 정의와 다름

④ digital: '디지털의' — 정의와 다름

questions.passage: Individuals differ in how they like to manage their time to meet work and outside __________ (responsible).
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 (1단어) (영어로) 쓰시오.

det.analysis: 빈칸 앞에 형용사 outside가 있고, 그 앞은 'work and outside ______'로 명사가 필요한 자리예요. 형용사 responsible(책임이 있는)을 명사 responsibility(책임)로 바꾸고, 업무·외부의 여러 일을 뜻하므로 복수형 responsibilities로 써요. '업무와 외부의 책임(들)을 다하기 위해'라는 뜻이 돼요.

questions.passage: This might entail constantly __________ (trade) text messages with children from the office, or monitoring emails at home and on vacation.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 (1단어) (영어로) 쓰시오.

det.korean: trade → trading: 뒤의 monitoring과 나란히 이어지는 동명사(-ing)
det.analysis: 빈칸은 'entail(수반하다)'의 목적어 자리예요. 뒤에 'or monitoring emails ...'가 나오므로, monitoring과 대등하게 연결되는 같은 형태가 필요해요. 동사 trade를 동명사 trading으로 바꿔 'trading ... or monitoring ...(문자를 주고받는 것, 또는 이메일을 확인하는 것)'으로 병렬을 맞춰요.

questions.passage: Boundaries between work and home are blurring as portable digital technology makes it increasingly possible to work anywhere, anytime. Individuals differ in how they like to manage their time to meet work and outside responsibilities. Some people prefer to separate or segment roles so that __________. For example, these people might keep separate email accounts for work and family and try to conduct work at the workplace and take care of family matters only during breaks and non-work time. We've even noticed more of these "segmenters" carrying two phones — one for work and one for personal use. Flexible schedules work well for these individuals because they enable greater distinction between time at work and time in other roles. Other individuals prefer integrating work and family roles all day long. This might entail constantly trading text messages with children from the office, or monitoring emails at home and on vacation, rather than returning to work to find hundreds of messages in their inbox.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 빈칸: boundary crossings are minimized(경계 넘나들기가 최소화되다)
det.analysis:
빈칸 앞은 '어떤 사람들은 역할을 분리(separate)하거나 나누기(segment)를 선호한다'는 흐름이에요. 뒤에 이어질 목적은 일과 가정을 넘나드는 일, 즉 '경계 넘나들기가 최소화되는(boundary crossings are minimized)' 것이에요.

① work never gets finished(일이 결코 끝나지 않는다): 분리의 목적과 무관

② family always comes first(가정이 항상 우선이다): 본문에 없는 내용

③ boundary crossings are minimized(경계 넘나들기가 최소화되다): 역할 분리의 목적에 맞아 정답 ← 정답

④ technology becomes useless(기술이 쓸모없어지다): 문맥과 반대

questions.passage: Boundaries between work and home are blurring as portable digital technology makes it increasingly possible to work anywhere, anytime. Individuals differ in how they like to manage their time to meet work and outside responsibilities. Some people prefer to separate or segment roles so that boundary crossings are minimized. For example, these people might keep separate email accounts for work and family and try to conduct work at the workplace and take care of family matters only during breaks and non-work time. We've even noticed more of these "segmenters" carrying two phones — one for work and one for personal use. Flexible schedules work well for these individuals because they enable greater distinction between time at work and time in other roles. Other individuals prefer __________ all day long. This might entail constantly trading text messages with children from the office, or monitoring emails at home and on vacation, rather than returning to work to find hundreds of messages in their inbox.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 빈칸: integrating work and family roles(일과 가정 역할을 통합하기)
det.analysis:
빈칸 뒤 문장은 '사무실에서 아이와 끊임없이 문자를 주고받거나, 집이나 휴가지에서 이메일을 확인한다'로, 일과 가정을 계속 섞는 행동이에요. 그러니 이 사람들은 '일과 가정 역할을 통합하기(integrating work and family roles)'를 선호해요.

① integrating work and family roles(일과 가정 역할을 통합하기): 뒤 예시와 맞아 정답 ← 정답

② avoiding all digital devices(모든 디지털 기기를 피하기): 이메일·문자 예시와 반대

③ working only at the office(사무실에서만 일하기): 집·휴가지에서도 일한다는 예시와 반대

④ keeping two phones apart(두 대의 전화를 따로 두기): 분리형(segmenter)의 특징이라 반대
det.tip: 일과 가정을 섞는 예시 → 역할 통합(integrating)
